name: The Stolen Tome
summary: In Northshire Valley, a novice human warlock is sent to recover a forbidden tome and prove their skill. Drusilla La Salle hopes to claim Powers of the Void from the Defias, whose camp lies in the vineyards.

sections.title: A Forbidden Opportunity
sections.body: Warlocks in Stormwind's lands hide their craft and keep prying eyes from their research. Northshire Abbey guards forbidden grimoires in its archives. Drusilla La Salle, the warlock mentor on the abbey grounds, covets Powers of the Void but cannot risk suspicion from the clerics and paladins by entering the library's protected wing herself.

sections.title: Defias Opportunism
sections.body: An abbey novice joins the Defias Brotherhood and steals several valuable texts on his way out. He flees to the Northshire Vineyards and takes refuge around the Defias campsite. The thieves stash their prize in a field tent, unaware of the danger in the book's dark arts.

sections.title: The First Binding
sections.body: Recovering the tome tests a novice warlock's nerve and opens the way to darker knowledge. Braving the bandit camp and returning the text satisfies Drusilla's ambition and proves the pupil is ready. She rewards the pupil with the dark rites to summon and bind an imp, the first demon an apprentice learns to command.

faq.q: What is the Powers of the Void?
faq.answer: Powers of the Void is a forbidden grimoire about dark magic and control of the planes. Kept in a guarded wing of the Northshire Abbey library, it holds knowledge Drusilla La Salle covets for her study and teachings.

faq.q: Why didn't Drusilla La Salle steal the book herself?
faq.answer: Drusilla La Salle must protect her standing at Northshire Abbey. Entering the library's secured archives would alert the clerics. When a novice stole the tome and joined the Defias, she had a chance to acquire it cleanly through an apprentice.

faq.q: Where is the stolen tome hidden?
faq.answer: The Defias hid the tome in a tent at their campsite in the Northshire Vineyards, east of the abbey.

faq.q: Why did a Northshire novice join the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Discontent and strife across the kingdom drive laborers, farmers, and church students to join the Defias Brotherhood. The novice abandoned his vows, stole several important books from the library, then fled to the vineyard bandits.

faq.q: What reward does a warlock get for retrieving the tome?
faq.answer: Returning the tome proves the pupil has the nerve and resilience to practice the dark arts. Drusilla rewards the apprentice with the teachings to summon an imp, their first demon.

faq.q: Do the Defias know how to use the book?
faq.answer: The bandits treat the stolen books as valuable plunder from the abbey. Though the Defias employ renegade spellcasters, the novice and his comrades tucked the tome into a tent crate instead of mastering its dark secrets.

angles.text: As a warlock, you prove you can cross dangerous ground without flinching. Securing the tome earns you the rites to call your first imp.
As a human, you see the Defias Brotherhood's reach in Northshire, where even abbey students steal sacred texts and join the insurrection.
As an Alliance member, you must tread softly around Northshire's paladins and clerics, using outlaws' mistakes to claim restricted occult knowledge.
